budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Use six finite parts to satisfy three chassis-plus-coil orders, reworking defects and matching requested coil colors, then physically carry valid products to the dock before their role-linked deadlines when possible.
task.natural_termination: All three product statuses are resolved as shipped (2) or rejected (3). Rejected orders are permanent negative outcomes. Ready but undelivered products do not count as completion. Otherwise truncate at 144 live transitions.
task.interaction: Routing, braking and occupied conveyor/machine buffers change partners available parts and delays. Inspection or recipe publication changes partner information. Shared power spent on one rework may prevent a different repair. Assembly permanently consumes two finite parts, and poor hidden-quality decisions impose shared losses.
task.observation_access: Partial native information with public geometry, positions, buffers, custody, processing, order deadlines, visible colors, status and events. The six actual defect bits are visible to role 1 or to everyone after part inspection/rework; requested coil colors are visible to role 2 or after a board publication. Explicit per-record mask rows accompany -1 for unknown bits. Separate quality/recipe entity groups use exactly those masks; the public part/order groups never expose the private attributes.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Part moved by the conveyor this turn
Station accepted a new job this turn
Existing station job completed this turn
Part quality explicitly inspected this turn
Order received a valid assembly this turn
Order consumed mismatching or defective parts this turn
Product reached the dock this turn

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
